subject.title: feat(cli): list and resolve pending approvals headlessly

question: Should OpenClaw expose a first-class headless CLI workflow for enumerating and resolving exec, plugin, and system-agent approvals, rather than limiting those decisions to chat and other approval surfaces?
rationale: The patch is a new public operator capability with remote-execution-grade authority; source review can verify scope use but cannot decide whether this terminal workflow is the intended product surface.

options.title: Sponsor the headless approvals CLI
options.body: Accept this as the supported operator workflow after a redacted live proof confirms the documented list and resolve behavior.

options.title: Keep approvals surface-specific
options.body: Decline the new CLI commands and keep resolution limited to existing chat or UI approval flows.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the headless approvals CLI
recommendation.body: Accept this as the supported operator workflow after a redacted live proof confirms the documented list and resolve behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The active proposal and its approval CLI constraints are concentrated in this contributor’s commits, making them the closest available routing contact.
